hookups.source: https://www.pa.gov/agencies/dcnr/recreation/where-to-go/state-parks/find-a-park/clear-creek-state-park/stay ('There are 52 campsites ... 41 campsites have electric hook ups') + ReserveAmerica per-site catalog for parkId 880201 (20 Modern Electric sites list 50-amp, 21 list 30-amp; no site lists water or sewer), read 2026-10-20

values.note: 52 campsites (41 Modern Electric, 11 Modern Non-Electric) besides 22 rustic cabins, 2 yurts and 2 canoe/kayak tent sites; DCNR and the booking site agree. Listed max vehicle lengths are 20 ft (21 sites), 30, 35 and 40 ft (11 sites at 40). Two electric sites (29 and 30, Front Section) are pull-through but list 20 ft; the rest are back-in.

sites.source: https://pennsylvaniastateparks.reserveamerica.com/camping/clear-creek-state-park/r/campgroundDetails.do?contractCode=PA&parkId=880201 (site list and each site's details page: Max Vehicle Length, Driveway Entry) + the DCNR stay page, read 2026-10-20

facilities.source: https://www.pa.gov/agencies/dcnr/recreation/where-to-go/state-parks/find-a-park/clear-creek-state-park/stay ('Showers, flush toilets, and a sanitary dump station are available') + ReserveAmerica park page amenities ('Potable Water'), read 2026-10-20

values.note: Campsites (Modern Electric, Modern Non-Electric) can be booked up to 11 months ahead and for the same day (ReserveAmerica booking window).

booking.source: https://pennsylvaniastateparks.reserveamerica.com/camping/clear-creek-state-park/r/campgroundDetails.do?contractCode=PA&parkId=880201 (Booking Window: 'Reservations can be made for today and can be made up to 11 Month(s) in advance'), read 2026-10-20

summary: Confirmed inherited reservable/ReserveAmerica/11-month window for this park. Added 50-amp electric (water/sewer not listed at any site, left unknown), 52 campsites up to 40 ft with two short pull-throughs, showers/flush toilets/potable water/dump. ReserveAmerica tags 15 RV sites 'Waterfront', consistent with the stored riverfront and the --AWH note. Not stated for this park: campground season (DCNR gives none; ReserveAmerica shows only a booking-season calendar), min/max stay, noon cutoff, fcfs. Fees left as recorded.
